incident: Project Brain completed its own 61-predicate Astra-themed internal suite.
Canonical state then promoted internal completion into full Astra external parity.
The internal suite itself did not constitute common-benchmark evidence against the external target.
This created a circular self-certification failure.
passing_condition: Future agents must describe 61/61 only as internal-suite completion and external Astra parity as unverified until common benchmark evidence exists.
